# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release is supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| latest (v0.4.x) | :white_check_mark: |
| older releases | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately via GitHub's
[Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/danieljustus/symaira-skills/security/advisories)
for this repository — do not open a public issue.

You can expect an acknowledgment within 5 business days. Please include:

- the affected version and platform
- a minimal reproduction (skill bundle, `symskills.toml`, commands run)
- impact assessment if known

We coordinate disclosure and publish a fix before details are made public.
